errors.text_span: Визуално сегментите във всички диаграми са подредени строго последователно в идентичен цветови и категорен ред по часовниковата стрелка, без да следват низходящ или възходящ ред спрямо техния процентен размер.
errors.evidence: The first two donut charts are not in a fixed identical clockwise category order across all three charts: each chart starts at the top with Industry, but the subsequent order differs by chart (e.g., in the first chart the segments proceed Industry → Construction → Trade → Other services, while in the second chart they proceed Industry → Construction → Trade → Other services but with different segment positions due to the varying slice sizes; the statement about an identical categorical order across all diagrams is misleading as a general structural description.
The description does not mention the chart title/subtitle visible at the top (the English title and the italic subtitle), which is part of the figure's visible presentation.
